_doc: Evaluation queries for earshot semantics, written from the manifest need names BEFORE any scores were looked at. 'classes' maps every manifest need to a class with two phrasings (a short agent-style query and a descriptive one). 'categories' is one natural query per asset folder. 'specific' are concrete needs with their correct files (ids). Caveat: 67 vocabulary terms were added later after seeing these classes (earshot/data/vocab.json _doc), so numbers on the 219-file tuning library are optimistic; the held-out library (heldout_labels.json) is the honest test.

categories.ambience: a continuous ambient background sound of a place
categories.foley: a close-up foley sound of a small object
categories.garden: sounds of grass, leaves, soil and wood outdoors in a garden
categories.magic: a bright magical chime, bell or celesta note
categories.motion: a whoosh of fast movement through the air
categories.toy: plastic toy clicks, snaps and latches
